entries.question: Three AKS Deployments consume one mutable ConfigMap that has just been updated. A reads its value from an environment variable at process startup. B reads a file mounted with subPath. The current Pods for A and B started before the update. C uses an ordinary ConfigMap volume and rereads the file per request; that file already shows the new value. During this configuration change, none of C’s existing Pods may be restarted or replaced. Which rollout plan makes the updated configuration available to all three applications within that restriction?
correctAnswerText: Roll out new Pods for A and B; leave C’s existing Pods unchanged.
entries.subskill: Deploy and manage applications to Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) by using manifest files
